Sam: Heads up — AcmeOne signed the NDA and asked for a completed SIG/CAIQ. Sales needs an ETA for the answers and who owns this. POC kickoff scheduled next Wed — any blockers?
Anya: Got it. Can you attach their questionnaire? Also need to confirm data residency requirements and whether PII will be uploaded.
Sam: Uploaded here: https://redwood-secure.atlassian.net/att/ACME/Q1/sig.pdf — they want EU-only, expect SOC2 evidence, and want KMS in their tenant. PII = yes (customer emails).
Ilya: We can draft CAIQ baseline by EOD Fri. For tenant KMS — that implies Private deployment or a dedicated key arrangement; will need infra + legal review. :thinking_face:
Devon: Customer expects a POC with sample data; can we use a pseudonymized dataset to avoid PHI exposure? They want results within two weeks.
Anya: PHI/personal data is a red flag. I'll start the security answers with conditional language and escalate the KMS request to Eng infra and Legal. Assigning to me to own this intake.
Anya: Interim ETA: CAIQ draft by Fri (EOD), KMS feasibility and infra path by Tue. If they insist on tenant-managed KMS for the POC we probably need a Private deployment evaluation — that'll change timelines.
Sam: OK — please list items I can share with the customer now (nonblocking).
Ilya: Share our SOC2 scope summary, encryption-at-rest docs, pen-test summary, and the CAIQ draft when it's ready. Don't promise tenant KMS until infra confirms feasibility.
infosec-bot: Task created: SEC-1724 — "AcmeOne SIG draft" assigned to Anya. Due 1767987634.
Anya: :thumbsup: I will upload the CAIQ draft to the secure drive and paste the link here plus a 2-line summary for Sales.
Devon: Thanks — I'll set the customer's expectation: CAIQ draft by Fri, KMS discussion next week.
Sam: Noted. Adding CRM reminder: next_checkin 1767960000, owner Sam. Ping me if infra/legal need anything to unblock.
